title: Little Pony and Summer Sun Celebration
titleZh: 小马驹与夏日太阳庆典
statementMd:
Twilight Sparkle learnt that the evil Nightmare Moon would return during the upcoming Summer Sun Celebration after one thousand years of imprisonment on the moon. She tried to warn her mentor Princess Celestia, but the princess ignored her and sent her to Ponyville to check on the preparations for the celebration.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b1c32d73d7fd0fa39b0359e41f5bb37c60cbe2fb.png)

Twilight Sparkle wanted to track the path of Nightmare Moon. Unfortunately, she didn't know the exact path. What she knew is the parity of the number of times that each place Nightmare Moon visited. Can you help Twilight Sparkle to restore any path that is consistent with this information?

Ponyville can be represented as an undirected graph (vertices are places, edges are roads between places) without self-loops and multi-edges. The path can start and end at any place (also it can be empty). Each place can be visited multiple times. The path must not visit more than $4*n*$ places.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}; 0 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the number of places and the number of roads in Ponyville. Each of the following $*m*$ lines contains two integers $*u*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *u*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*; *u*_{*i*} ≠ *v*_{*i*}$), these integers describe a road between places $*u*_{*i*}$ and $*v*_{*i*}$.

The next line contains $*n*$ integers: $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$ $(0 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 1)$ — the parity of the number of times that each place must be visited. If $*x*_{*i*} = 0$, then the $*i*$-th place must be visited even number of times, else it must be visited odd number of times.

## Output

Output the number of visited places $*k*$ in the first line ($0 ≤ *k* ≤ 4*n*$). Then output $*k*$ integers — the numbers of places in the order of path. If $*x*_{*i*} = 0$, then the $*i*$-th place must appear in the path even number of times, else $*i*$-th place must appear in the path odd number of times. Note, that given road system has no self-loops, therefore any two neighbouring places in the path must be distinct.

If there is no required path, output `-1`. If there multiple possible paths, you can output any of them.
statementZhMd:
Twilight Sparkle 得知，邪恶的 Nightmare Moon 在月球上被囚禁一千年后，将于即将到来的夏日太阳庆典期间回归。她试图警告她的导师 Celestia 公主，但公主没有理会她，而是将她送往 Ponyville，检查庆典的准备工作。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b1c32d73d7fd0fa39b0359e41f5bb37c60cbe2fb.png)

Twilight Sparkle 想要追踪 Nightmare Moon 的路径。然而遗憾的是，她不知道确切的路径。她所知道的是 Nightmare Moon 访问每个地点的次数的奇偶性。你能帮助 Twilight Sparkle 还原出一条与这些信息一致的路径吗？

Ponyville 可以表示为一个无向图（顶点表示地点，边表示连接地点的道路），图中没有自环和重边。路径可以从任意地点开始，也可以在任意地点结束（也可以为空）。每个地点可以被访问多次。路径访问的地点数不得超过 $4*n*$。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}; 0 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5}$）——Ponyville 中地点和道路的数量。接下来的 $*m*$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $*u*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *u*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*; *u*_{*i*} ≠ *v*_{*i*}$），表示一条连接地点 $*u*_{*i*}$ 和 $*v*_{*i*}$ 的道路。

下一行包含 $*n*$ 个整数：$*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*$（$0 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 1$）——每个地点必须被访问次数的奇偶性。如果 $*x*_{*i*} = 0$，则第 $*i*$ 个地点必须被访问偶数次；否则必须被访问奇数次。

## 输出格式

第一行输出访问的地点数 $*k*$（$0 ≤ *k* ≤ 4*n*$）。然后输出 $*k*$ 个整数，表示路径中地点出现的顺序。如果 $*x*_{*i*} = 0$，则第 $*i*$ 个地点必须在路径中出现偶数次；否则第 $*i*$ 个地点必须在路径中出现奇数次。注意，由于给定的道路系统没有自环，因此路径中任意两个相邻地点必须不同。

如果不存在满足要求的路径，输出 `-1`。如果存在多条可行路径，输出其中任意一条即可。
